title: Straight bar / Push-in socket
insertion_note: Straight axial push-in from each outer end. Removal is a direct pull while the outer throat relaxes enough to let the housing pass back out.
plug_retention_note: Firm plug retention happens at the close-fit inner plug pocket and the shoulder between the housing chamber and the smaller plug recess.
housing_retention_note: Moderate housing retention comes from the recessed mouth being smaller than the housing envelope, while still large enough for repeated snap-in use.
material_note: Best for firmer TPU or semi-rigid elastomer. The body stays more solid and relies on a shallow snap throat instead of large flex windows.

title: Straight bar / Press-fit recess
insertion_note: Axial press-in through a narrower snap throat. Removal uses a peel-and-pull motion so the relief windows can open before the housing clears.
plug_retention_note: Firm plug retention comes from the same stepped plug pocket, but with a tighter entry throat so the tip stays deep in the blind recess during wear.
housing_retention_note: Moderate housing retention is handled by the compliant snap throat and flanking relief slots so the housing is captured without needing a hard rigid clamp.
material_note: Best for soft TPU or silicone-like elastomer. The retention comes from a more aggressive snap mouth backed by side relief slots.

title: Straight bar / Side-entry slide-in
insertion_note: Lateral slide-in through mirrored side channels, then a short inward push seats the plug against the blind stop. Removal reverses that slide while the lips flex.
plug_retention_note: Firm plug retention occurs at the blind inner plug pocket; the plug cannot translate far enough to escape unless the whole connector is first slid back to the side slot.
housing_retention_note: Moderate housing retention comes from top and bottom lips over the side channel, which keep the housing captured while leaving insertion force manageable.
material_note: Best for medium-flex elastomer. It splits the difference between secure snap-in retention and easier removal.
